summary: Phase 3 of tane: a zoomable SVG map is Explore's main view (area bubbles sized by idea count zoom to themes, ideas and the idea page), link lines styled per supports/contradicts/extends, the owner's own ideas drawn in their own style, Back and a Map|List toggle, and map filters (folder, written about, untouched, mine).
why: Lets the owner explore the whole library visually, drill down, and keep logging notes on the side.
